notes: kb/Work PB5575. §2002:15.30.3 RV1: EXP10 is (10 ** (argument-1)); a non-integer power's value is the implementor's (§2002:8.8.1.3.6 r2e) stored in a standard intermediate data item, so EXP10 (.5) is the square root of 10 truncated to 32 digits, 3.1622776601683793319988935444327, and an integer power develops per multiplication (CobolDec.PowStandard).
